## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Name any prerequisite PR.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Distinguish direct MCP verification, client configuration, and live host acceptance. Link CI and state any blocked checks.

## Review

- [ ] Focused scope; 2–3 commits where useful, never more than 4.
- [ ] Existing client settings and skill installations are preserved or backed up.
- [ ] Personal settings, credentials, private artifacts, and machine paths are absent.
- [ ] Upstream version, license, and attribution changes are recorded if applicable.
- [ ] Documentation matches verified behavior and states remaining limits.
